  · section-gap (hatched spacer band)
  [block-code-split-accelerator kind=left]
    h2 "Fine-tune cache policies for your content"
    p "Configure caching policies that match your content strategy."
    button "Learn More" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/build/applications/cache-settings/
    [code-code-block]
      text "cache-settings.json"
      icon-button "Copy the code sample"
      text: browser_cache_settings": { ⏎ ttl": 3600, ⏎ honor_origin_headers": true ⏎ }, ⏎ cdn_cache_settings": { ⏎ ttl": 86400, ⏎ stale_cache_enabled": true, ⏎ tiered_cache_enabled": true ⏎ }, ⏎ cache_key_settings": { ⏎ query_strings": "all", ⏎ cookies": [] ⏎ }, ⏎ large_file_optimization": { ⏎ enabled": true, ⏎ fragment_size_kb": 1024
